readmeHtml:
Video tools for the agent era.

Video Creation

  • Make videos agentically: Turn your idea into a video using your coding agent.
  • Make videos interactively: Edit and animate using drag and drop.
  • Make videos programmatically: Connect to data, and manage complexity with code.

React Code is the source of truth. Switch your workflow at any point.

Video Automation

  • Design systems: Create a library of animated assets for your organization.
  • Batch rendering: Render millions of videos on your own infrastructure.
  • Applications: Publish a simple tool or a complex video editor.

Get started

If you already have Node.JS installed, type

npx create-video@latest

to get started. Otherwise, read the installation page in the documentation.

Discover Remotion

Remotion is extensively documented over more than 1000 pages.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A framework for creating highly dynamic, data-driven videos programmatically using React.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Remotion is a powerful framework that allows developers to write, render, and automate video production using standard web technologies like React, HTML, and CSS. By treating video frames as precise React component states, it enables the creation of highly dynamic, parameter-driven content that can be updated in real-time. The platform includes a comprehensive suite of tools for timeline management, audio synchronization, and high-performance server-side rendering. This approach completely transforms video creation from a manual, linear editing process into a scalable, automated software engineering task tailored for the AI agent era.
keyFeatures: React-Based Rendering: Utilizes standard React components to define video scenes, animations, and visual elements.
Parametric Video Creation: Allows videos to be dynamically generated and customized based on external data sources or API inputs.
Precise Timeline Control: Provides robust hooks and utilities for managing frame-accurate animations and sequence timing.
Server-Side Rendering: Enables the automated generation of high-quality MP4 videos in CI/CD pipelines or cloud environments.
Agentic Workflow Support: Designed to allow coding agents to programmatically generate and iterate on video content.

useCases.title: Automated Marketing Content
useCases.description: Programmatically generate personalized promotional videos at scale based on user data or product catalogs.

useCases.title: Dynamic Data Visualization
useCases.description: Create engaging, animated video reports that visualize complex datasets, analytics, or financial metrics.

useCases.title: Agent-Driven Video Creation
useCases.description: Enable AI coding agents to rapidly prototype and render video ideas into final products.

useCases.title: Social Media Automation
useCases.description: Build systems that automatically render and publish daily summary videos or trend reports directly to social platforms.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Remotion is tailored for web developers, content creators, and AI engineers who want to automate and scale their video production. It requires a solid understanding of React, CSS, and modern web development practices.
